title: SyntheticData
summary: A Streamlit-style UI application (upload.py, model.py, evaluation.py, visualize.py) that lets a user upload a CSV, generate synthetic tabular data with several generative models, and visualize/evaluate the result. It wraps SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN) for generation and calls sdv.evaluation and sdmetrics report utilities for diagnostics and quality plots, making SDV the core generation and evaluation engine.
